Senior PM — Activation, consumer edtech, London hybrid.

Lingoleap (London, 150 people, profitable) runs a language-learning app with a freemium model. We're hiring a Senior PM to own activation: the first-week learning streak, free-to-paid conversion and paywall experiments. You'll work with a pod of four engineers and a designer, no direct reports, reporting to the Group PM. Hybrid, two days a week. You've owned a freemium-to-paid funnel at scale before; edtech experience is not required.
